Single motor keyboard jog

Connect one board, then hold an arrow key or an on-screen arrow. Up / Right turn forward; Down / Left turn backward. Hold to accelerate and release to slow down. Opposite directions cancel.

Saved positions

GOTO returns the motor to its saved commanded position using the selected step size’s target speed with fixed 400 ms ramps. Short moves may finish before reaching that speed. Positions use commanded steps from this power-on session; they do not measure the motor or track manual movement. Save only while stopped. Board restarts invalidate saved positions.

Motion details

No homing or travel limits. Stay clear of the ends. Direction depends on wiring; physical distance is uncalibrated. Focus loss, connection loss and faults stop immediately. Coils release when stopped. Supported step sizes and driver behavior are read from the connected board.

Connect one board with updated responsive jog firmware. Arrow controls are available as soon as the board is connected and healthy.
